recognize_zh: 中倍視野下骨髓細胞密度高，脂肪空泡之間可見多顆大型巨核細胞（部分兩三顆靠近），核分葉、細胞質豐富且無明顯異型，背景為成熟中的紅血球與顆粒球系，符合 ITP 的巨核細胞增加。
features: Cellular marrow fragment with interspersed round fat spaces
Increased megakaryocytes, mostly single with occasional adjacent pairs, not forming dense clusters
Megakaryocytes large with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and lobulated nuclei
Background trilineage hematopoiesis with prominent erythroid precursors and granulocytes
No fibrosis, granulomas or abnormal infiltrate in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a cellular fragment with trilineage hematopoiesis and interspersed adipocytes. Megakaryocytes are increased, mostly dispersed singly with an occasional adjacent pair, and are large with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and lobulated nuclei without significant atypia. No fibrosis, granulomas or neoplastic infiltrate is seen in this field. In a patient with isolated thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with immune thrombocytopenia (ITP).

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are giant and hyperlobated in loose clusters with thrombocytosis, while ITP megakaryocytes are normal-appearing with a low platelet count.
PMF shows dense clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei and granulocytic proliferation, not the unremarkable megakaryocytes here.
Marrow may be similar; splenomegaly and involvement of other cell lines point to sequestration rather than immune destruction.
